blocks.content: If we try solving the problem with the same logic as before, we will find that every item has the same value per weight, which is $100/unit.
So, our greedy approach here will simply be:

items: Pick the most expensive thing that will fit in your knapsack.
Pick the next most expensive thing that will fit in your knapsack. And so on.

blocks.content: This means we will start with the $3000 TV that weighs 30 units and will be left with 5 units in our knapsack.
Since no other items will fit inside the knapsack, our solution brings us goods worth $3000.
